title: One year anniversary of ARC Raiders: Thanks for being here!
body:
# One year anniversary of ARC Raiders: Thanks for being here!

Hey Raiders,

Can you believe it? Today marks one year of ARC Raiders!

You've spent more time Topside in this first year than we ever expected - thank you for joining us in the Rust Belt and making it your own.

Here are some of the wildest numbers from your first year of raiding:

# Frozen Trail

We've loved watching you explore the Frozen Trail update and push yourselves against the new content we've built. We're already hard at work on what's coming next, but take a moment to see what players are saying about the new update and our first year in orbit.

# Get your gift!

We'd like to give you a small token of thanks for playing ARC Raiders and helping us shape this game's future. Log in to the game to claim your free gift - it will be waiting in your inbox!

Raiders, here's to another year. We have a lot planned for what's ahead, and we hope you'll stay with us for the ride.

See you Topside,

The ARC Raiders Team
